name: Anagram Check
description: Checks if two strings are anagrams (contain the same characters with the same frequencies) using character frequency counting.
aim: Determine if two strings are anagrams by counting character frequencies: two strings are anagrams if their frequency maps are identical.
howItWorks: Count frequency of each character in string 1
Subtract frequency of each character in string 2
If all counts are zero: anagrams
Alternatively: sort both strings and compare

complexity.spaceDescription: Fixed-size character frequency array (256 ASCII or 26 letters)

realWorld: Word game AI (Scrabble, Words with Friends)
Detecting identical content with different encoding
whenToUse: Check if two strings are rearrangements
Group strings that are anagrams of each other
alternatives: Sorting approach — O(n log n) but simpler
Prime product — clever but overflow risk
